name: Defendable
security_staff_note: Guarded estimate by the list maintainer (@whatsdd) and not published by the company: the headcount this entity filed with Enhetsregisteret, which is a security-only business, so the whole payroll is security work. It is the entity's headcount rather than a measured split, which is why it is an estimate and a floor.
delivery_note: Delivery model recorded from the company's own description of how it staffs the work.
specialty: Norwegian MDR and incident response house, spun out of BDO Cybersecurity.
notes: Registry history: BESEC AS -> DEFENDABLE AS. The company was spun out of BDO Cybersecurity and launched as an independent company in 2021.
